objective: Cousin Amal moves to a new address. She announces it from her known address, and Leila has already updated her address book entry. The closing thank-you and the future reference must use the new address; the album share stays as it is.

set.body:
Leila, the album was the hit of yesterday. Jiddo's picnic page made Dad cry. Thank you for doing all of this.

One more thing: the family email plan ends this month, so this address stops working on 30 November. Please use amal.haddad@example.test from now on.

Amal

set.notes: Cousin, Uncle Sami's daughter. Ann Arbor. New address from 27 Nov (told me at the reunion).
